item.title: Qualifications & mode
item.description:
shAstrArtha debate

If there is any controversy or dispute, you should participate in a proper shastrartha (scholarly debate) there instead of uploading trivial and unnecessary videos on YouTube.

  • @रंजनमंडल-छ5प

However, the right place to take that grievance is to the source—Sringeri—rather than sowing doubt (dhwandhwa) among viewers in a YouTube comment section. - @jayanthkumarnataraja137

This is just your prejudice and ignorant. Scholarly debate can take any of the following froms:

item.title: Topic choice
item.description:
Christianity?

In contemporary times, buddhism or jainism are no longer in majority. Earlier they were even royal religions. Why no such khandana granthas not being written against currently widespread religions like islam/christianity? We don’t see any debate with christians even though they are not so violent if that is the concern. - @srikkanthank

  1. They were thought to be unworthy of consideration - easily dismissed as barbarians. However, Arumukha navalAr the shaiva v4, Bhuvanagiri the SV v4 to a lesser extant did counter. In current times, https://www.shivashakthi.org/ is doing commendable work.
